attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **This is not the corpus's `kindeos-of-pisidia`**, whose Greek row is already venerated on 20 Φεβρουαρίου off saint.gr's own «Όσιος Κινδέος Επίσκοπος Πισιδίας» and whose folder makes him a venerable bishop: that row is left where it is. This entry is a presbyter, from the town of Talmenia in the Pamphylia of Side, denounced to the eparch Stratonikos and burned alive. saint.gr keeps the two on two days with two ranks, two provinces and two deaths, and the corpus's settled rule is that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations; the identity is named as an open question in the reader's report all the same. He is likewise neither Canides of Cappadocia nor Kendeas. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn.
